_meta.source: Marvel Splendor card list supplied by the project owner ("Marvel Splendor Expansion Cards.csv"), transcribed from card scans. Stone colors: yellow->mind, blue->space, orange->soul, red->reality, purple->power.
_meta.ids: c<level>-<nn>, numbered in the CSV's order within each level. Saved games refer to cards by id, so never reuse or renumber an id.
_meta.timeStone: Every level 3 card bears the Time Stone icon; the UI and engine derive it from the level.
_meta.side: Each card is a "hero", a "villain", or "both" for one that could go either way. It plays no part in the rules; it is what the hero and villain stats count, and a "both" card counts once as each.
_meta.groups: The teams a card belongs to, three at most; none is allowed. The collection page makes a row for every team that three or more cards belong to, and puts the rest under Others, so a new team appears by itself once it has three cards.
